A.name: NEVER_ON_FRONT
A.condition: correct_on_front(seed) is false for all 30 seeds

B.name: LOST_IN_RETENTION
B.condition: correct_on_front(seed) true for >=1 seed AND retained_correct(seed) false for all 30 seeds

C.name: LOST_IN_CROSS_SEED_AGGREGATION
C.meaning: survives within-seed retention but lost in cross-seed vote
C.condition: >=1 seed retains correct row AND representative not g2_correct AND representative not algebraically_equivalent to truth

D.name: LOST_IN_CROSS_SEED_CLASSIFICATION
D.meaning: survives aggregation but lost to equivalence/classification
D.condition: >=1 seed retains correct row AND representative not g2_correct AND representative IS algebraically_equivalent to truth

classifier_functions.correct_on_front: g2_contract.evaluate_g2_event == SUCCESS, i.e. classify_support == MATCH and classify_family_match == MATCH
classifier_functions.retained_correct: policy's own within-seed retained row is itself g2_correct
classifier_functions.cross_seed_grouping: rc5_selection.group_and_select, unmodified, fed policy's vote-reduced RetainedCandidate per seed
classifier_functions.truth_equivalence_check: discovery.equivalence.algebraically_equivalent, up to a positive multiplicative constant

primary_endpoint.name: conditional_retention_recall
primary_endpoint.formula: count(cases in eligible_pool where truth survives retention under P) / count(eligible_pool)
primary_endpoint.eligible_pool: cases not in stage A (correct_on_front true for >=1 of 30 seeds); cardinality is policy-invariant
primary_endpoint.truth_survives_retention: at least one of the case's 30 seeds retains a g2_correct row under policy P's own within-seed rule, applied to the frozen, already-persisted front
primary_endpoint.comparison_type: paired at case level (same eligible pool, same front, across all policies)

execution_trigger.evaluated_once: immediately after E2a seals, before any policy is scored
execution_trigger.population_for_gate: full 540 E2a cases (not the DEV/EVAL split)

gate_1_falsification_hook.condition: E2b direct measurement contradicts v1 decomposition's 69/57 retention-vs-generation split by more than 10 cases (PE2-4 tolerance)
gate_1_falsification_hook.reason: MURU_V2_G2_PARETO_STUDY_DESIGN.md#section-2.9 falsification hook; all E4 ablations suspended

branches.reason: RC3 confirmed by direct observation; E4a enabled (decision tree B.1)

branches.condition: P_retain_given_front near 1 wherever P_front is high
branches.reason: RC3 withdrawn; no retention change licensed

branches.condition: A is the strict plurality of {A, B, C+D}
branches.reason: RC4 confirmed; next step is E3-gated (E4b/c/d), not this protocol

branches.condition: (C + D) is the strict plurality of {A, B, C+D}
branches.reason: RC7 larger than v1's 2 cases; E4f (classifier/voting) is licensed instead; metrics still reported diagnostically

branches.condition: no strict plurality among {A, B, C+D}
branches.reason: decision tree does not cover a non-plurality outcome; adoption rule (section 10) suspended pending named tie-break review

policies.notes: frozen v1 production rule; reproduces E2a's own sealed labels exactly

policies.selection_rule: smallest grid value whose paired improvement over R0 has a 95% bootstrap lower bound above 0 on V2C_RET_DEV; if none qualifies, R2 is disqualified from adoption
policies.vote_reduction: argmax(valid_r2) among the k retained rows

policies.exclusion_reason: definitionally near-tautological recall; measures the retention ceiling only, per explicit mission instruction to prevent a policy winning by retaining everything

policies.description: among rows with valid_r2 >= max(valid_r2) - eps, keep the lowest-complexity row
policies.selection_rule: smallest grid value whose paired improvement over R0 has a 95% bootstrap lower bound above 0 on V2C_RET_DEV; if none qualifies, R4 is disqualified from adoption
policies.vote_reduction: argmax(valid_r2) among the eps-band retained rows (degenerate: band retains exactly one row per seed by construction, so no reduction needed)

policies.description: row survives iff no other row on the same front has valid_r2 >= its own and complexity <= its own, with at least one strict inequality
policies.vote_reduction: argmax(valid_r2) among the nondominated retained rows

policies.description: top-3 rows by score, further restricted to rows whose template_key recurs in the top-3 of at least 2 of the world's other 29 seeds
policies.constant_selection: frozen directly, not Development-tuned; shortlist_size matches R2's own grid value k=3, min_recurrence=2 is the minimal above-chance corroboration threshold

vote_reduction_rule_general: for any policy retaining more than one row per seed, the seed's single cross-seed vote is cast by the argmax(valid_r2) row among that seed's own retained set; held fixed across every policy

dev_split.name: V2C_RET_DEV
dev_split.role: constant selection only (R2 k, R4 eps); never used for headline comparison
dev_split.stratification: exactly 2 of 12 replicates per (family, regime, noise) cell across all 45 cells

eval_split.name: V2C_RET_EVAL
eval_split.role: all headline metrics, all adoption decisions, all pre-registered predictions
eval_split.stratification: exactly 10 of 12 replicates per (family, regime, noise) cell across all 45 cells

required_metrics.population: mass_power truth cases in V2C_RET_EVAL (36 of 450)
required_metrics.caveat: necessary_not_sufficient; formal E6 run required before adoption

required_metrics.definition: fraction of eligible_pool reaching stage E under P

statistics.primary_interval: case-level bootstrap, B=10000, resampled within V2C_RET_EVAL only
statistics.bootstrap_seed_construction: derive_seed_v2('bootstrap', '<policy_id>') truncated to 64-bit unsigned, V2C namespace
statistics.multiplicity_correction: Holm-Bonferroni at alpha=0.05 across the 6 head-to-head comparisons (R1, R2*, R3, R4*, R5, R6 vs R0); raw and adjusted both reported

controls: replay_self_consistency: R0 must reproduce E2a's own sealed A/B/C/D/E counts and selection_count values exactly
frozen_front: static import check forbids rc5_estimate/rc5_adapter/PySR/Julia imports in this protocol's implementation

criteria_all_required: paired bootstrap 95% lower bound of conditional_retention_recall improvement over R0 is above 0
false_structure_rate_proxy does not exceed R0's own by more than 0.15 Wilson-upper margin (necessary, not sufficient; formal E6 run still required)
cross_seed_stability 20-of-30 clearing fraction does not fall below R0's own
for R2/R4 only: grid value was selected on V2C_RET_DEV per section 6.1 and not disqualified there
tie_break_lexicographic: ladder_index: R0 < R1 < R5 < R6 < R2 < R4
adoption_rule.no_eligible_arm_outcome: NO_CHANGE_LICENSED; frozen R0 stands; RC3 attribution revised downward

out_of_scope: Held-out or Challenge access (static import-graph check enforced)

pre_registered_predictions.statement: R3 conditional_retention_recall on V2C_RET_EVAL is at or within Wilson noise of 1.0 for every family except mass_saturating_descriptor
at least one of R2*, R4*, R5 clears the adoption bar, conditional on Gate 2 selecting the retention-dominant branch
R6's recall improvement over R0 is smaller than R2*/R4's, but its false_structure_rate_proxy is the lowest non-control arm
mass_saturating_descriptor is the worst_family_performance family for every policy including R3 (ceiling set by stage A, not B)
stage D is small relative to stage C across every policy
